buildings_screened.method: datasets-server search ('apartment building', 'residential house'; other queries timed out), family 'building', about 100 rows seen as preview renders; 7 downloaded at the pinned revision, checksums compared, read (pure meshes, no references or payloads), imported in Blender 5.2 and measured
buildings_screened.criterion: a low-rise home of three storeys at about 3 m each, at true or uniformly scaled size, in a style the Studio can match; no stretching of storeys (review R2)
buildings_screened.result: none met it; the building family is mostly roof-truss models, towers, sheds and 1-2 storey houses
